LIFFEYSIDE CARDIAC CENTRE - TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER Liffeyside General Hospital, Cardio-Obstetric Clinic Patient: HAVRYLENKO, Oksana DOB: 19/05/2061 MRN: LGH 20-448193 Age: 21 y Date: 31/05/2082 (Sunday), 19:40 Spoken with: patient, then partner Ruairi Keane Interpreter: not needed (patient speaks English, Ukrainian and some Russian) Phone: +353 87 555 0142
Dr. Esteban Villaverde Mora on call for cardiology, I take the call from the midwife Orla Wren who is in the patient home for a domiciliary visit.
History: 21 years old woman, pregnant of 34 weeks + 2 days (EDD aprox 10/07/2082), first pregnancy. She has not known cardiac disease. No cardiac medication. Before pregnancy she used contraceptive pill (Natazia, then Trinessa) until 01/2081. Since morning she have headache frontal, "flashes" in the eyes and swelling of the feet, no chest pain, no palpitation, a little dispnea when she climb the stairs of her flat. Measure by midwife with automatic machine: BP 164/108 right arm, repeated after ten minutes 158/104, pulse 92. Urine dipstick protein ++. Temperature normal. No seizure, no fits, no loss of conscience.
Assessment: Hipertensive disorder of pregnancy with severe range blood pressure and neurological symptoms. In our system is code as "eclampsia in pregnancy" (31/05/2082), but she did not have a seizure, so we keep it like severe pre-eclampsia until the obstetric team decide. Plan: 1. I have indicated to go immediately to the maternity unit of Liffeyside General Hospital, not to drive herself, the partner Ruairi take her by car (reg 08-D-44721), 20 minutes. 2. I call to the obstetric registrar Prof. Niamh Brannigan who accept her. Labetalol per obstetric protocol, not by us. 3. Tomorrow morning chest X-ray and cardiac check, I will order with the radiology, because the dispnea. 4. Patient and partner understand, repeated back in English. Her mother Halyna in Lviv, Ukraine, is informed by partner by Whatsapp, number +380 32 555 0178.
